svg.title: Study overview of causal forecasting and bidirectional masked reconstruction
svg.desc: Four stages: actual predictable-oscillator and multichannel EEG data; separate Transformer waveform objectives; frozen patch embeddings; waveform prediction through reconstruction heads and frozen readouts for content and diagnosis. Waveform evaluation applies to both datasets, latent recovery to synthetic data, spectral accessibility and diagnosis to EEG. All signal traces come from the archived actual study examples. Patch counts are schematic.
